use.t: 用标题、列表和代码块整理给 AI 的上下文
保存 AI 输出的标题、表格、列表和代码块，方便继续处理
编写 README、需求文档和适合 Git 协作的说明
做笔记和知识库：文件轻、不绑定软件，换编辑器或多年以后仍然打得开

dont.t: 未确认目标是否支持 Markdown 就直接粘贴：# 和 ** 可能原样显示，先预览或转成纯文本
需要交付 Word 文档时应另行导出或转换，并保留原始 .md 文件
不要依赖连续空格或随意换行凑对齐；不同 Markdown 渲染器的折叠规则可能不同
代码块开头写了 ``` 却缺少结尾：后续内容可能被解析为代码块

lessonPractice.title: 团队要用 Git 共同维护一份包含操作步骤和命令的 README。哪种交付方式最合适？

options.label: 用 Markdown 写标题、列表和代码块，提交前检查预览
options.feedback: Markdown 同时保留可读结构和纯文本内容，命令能复制，修改也能在 Git 中逐行审查。

options.label: 在文档软件里排版，再把每一页导出成图片提交
options.feedback: 图片能保留外观，但文字难以复制、搜索和逐行比较，不适合持续协作的 README。

options.label: 使用纯文本并靠连续空格、空行把内容推到目标位置
options.feedback: 不同编辑器会用不同字体和换行宽度，空格排版无法稳定表达标题、列表和代码边界。

en.title: A team will maintain a README with procedures and commands through Git. Which delivery format fits best?

options.label: Use Markdown headings, lists, and code blocks, then check the rendered preview
options.feedback: Markdown keeps readable structure in plain text, so commands remain copyable and changes can be reviewed line by line.

options.label: Lay it out in a document editor and commit an image of every page
options.feedback: Images preserve appearance, but their text is difficult to copy, search, and compare line by line.

options.label: Use plain text and align sections with repeated spaces and blank lines
options.feedback: Editors use different fonts and wrapping widths, so spacing cannot reliably express headings, lists, or code boundaries.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请把这份 README 整理成 Markdown：用标题建立层级，用列表写步骤，用代码块包住可复制命令。不要靠连续空格对齐；完成后检查 Markdown 预览和代码块闭合。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Restructure this README as Markdown: use headings for hierarchy, lists for steps, and fenced code blocks for copyable commands. Do not align with repeated spaces, and verify the rendered preview and every closing fence.

scenes: AI 聊天的格式化回答

use.t: Organize context for AI with headings, lists and code blocks
Save structured AI output for further editing
Write README files and project documents as versionable plain text
Keep plain-text notes readable across editors

dont.t: Paste without checking Markdown support: preview first, or convert to plain text
Convert or export separately when Word is required, keeping the original .md file
Use repeated spaces or arbitrary line breaks for alignment across renderers
Open a fenced code block without closing it, so later prose becomes code
